charge_port.notes: GM: Escalade IQ and IQL get a native NACS port for model year 2027 (autoevolution; InsideEVs 810603 and TTAC agree). US.

supercharger_access.notes: Native NACS: Superchargers need no adapter; CCS stalls need a NACS-to-CCS adapter. US.

consumption_highway_wh_per_km.notes: Estimated (B103): the 2025 Escalade IQ's measured 70 mph highway figure (InsideEVs), same pack and motors. 2027 changed the charge port and charger, not the drive unit. No 2027 test or regulator rating found.

range_km.notes: Advertised 465 miles, powertrain unchanged (News Wheel, relaying GM). GM pressroom (via search excerpt) says EPA estimate not yet available, subject to change before production. low_confidence. Manufacturer estimate, not an EPA/NRCan rating (B97).

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: TTAC ("every Escalade IQ trim comes standard with a 19.2-kW on-board charger") and InsideEVs (more powerful charger standard across all trims) state it; GM did not announce it (GM Authority found it), so not recorded as manufacturer. US sources; Canada unverified.
